openings.claim: Maintain surname dividers with a live exception slip, recording household-name discrepancies and updating locations whenever books move.
openings.discriminator: Verified addresses reduce second searches; unchanged delays concentrated in the busy interval favor queue congestion.
openings.probe: Bound the paper trial; record address correctness, second searches, queue presence, preparation and reconciliation time. Verify claimant-to-hold entitlement before handoff.
openings.uncertainty: Household mismatches may not explain second searches; service-time update feasibility and adequate verification are unestablished.

openings.claim: Leave verified household-surname misplacements in place and record intended-reader-to-actual-shelf pointers; the discrepancy becomes a secondary address. Household membership does not establish entitlement.
openings.discriminator: Pointers should retrieve correct holds while misplaced placement persists; reshelving should restore successful primary-region searches. Stale or wrong-household candidates defeat pointer usefulness.
openings.probe: Within total preparation budget, index only verified discrepancies; log pointer use, locations searched, duration and rejected candidates. Update or invalidate pointers after moves.
openings.uncertainty: Reliable reader assignment, handoff verification, spare preparation capacity and sustainable pointer upkeep are unknown.

openings.claim: Existing-cart retrieval may outperform alphabetic shelving for new arrivals; ten fast synthetic pickups refute universally faster shelving.
openings.discriminator: Comparable cart cohorts remain faster; disappearing advantage with arrival volume or book size favors sample selection. Capacity or correctness failures defeat retention.
openings.probe: Observe naturally occurring cart and shelf pickups with existing timing paper, recording volume and size; unmatched cohorts are inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Comparable cohorts, cart capacity and routine retention effectiveness are unknown.

lineage.reason: Preserves distinct defect-as-routing-signal relation and reshelving rival.
Preserves cart hypothesis and selection rival.

decision: Use bounded probes before adoption. Only the existing clerk hands off; names/contact details stay behind desk; use two shelves and one cart; daily preparation stays within ten clerk-minutes. All evidence is synthetic. At least 95% within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs remain unproven; interview representativeness is unknown.
